name: Renderers, materialization, drift detection and sync
scope: Implement renderer registry and Markdown renderer contract.
Implement affected-only materialization and full clean regeneration.
Implement `sync` orchestration: check, deterministic rebuild, materialize, leave semantic review unresolved.

pre_execution_questions.question: Как определять ownership/drift generated Markdown: marker в файле или digest в runtime state?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Нужно отличать generated view от plain Markdown и ловить ручные edits.
pre_execution_questions.recommended_default: Use explicit materialization registration + stored output digest/provenance; do not require visible marker in document content by default.
pre_execution_questions.answer: Use explicit materialization registration + stored output digest/provenance; do not require visible marker in document content by default.
pre_execution_questions.decision: Adopt this implementation default for v0.1 unless implementation evidence exposes a contradiction.

pre_execution_questions.question: Нужен ли filesystem watch/daemon в первой рабочей версии?

emergent_questions.question: How should P5 sync treat a mixed dependency cycle where a semantic target depends on a derived builder target that in turn reads the semantic target?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: P4 independently rejects pure semantic cycles and P2 rejects recursive builder cycles, but the persisted mixed graph can still contain A(semantic) → B(derived field) → A. P5 affected traversal/sync must have explicit termination semantics.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Do not auto-accept semantic edges. Detect mixed strongly-connected components during sync planning; deterministic work may run at most once per current state occurrence, then sync stops with attention_required on the semantic member. Treat all-deterministic executable cycles as errors.
emergent_questions.answer: Permit mixed semantic↔deterministic SCCs only with bounded sync: deterministic members run at most once per sync occurrence; semantic members are never auto-accepted and affected mixed SCCs return attention_required. Pure deterministic executable cycles remain errors.
emergent_questions.decision: Permit mixed semantic↔deterministic SCCs only with bounded sync: deterministic members run at most once per sync occurrence; semantic members are never auto-accepted and affected mixed SCCs return attention_required. Pure deterministic executable cycles remain errors.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved before P5 acceptance; prevents non-terminating sync without weakening semantic agency.

emergent_questions.question: What should sync do when a previously registered materialization target is removed or renamed and its old generated file now looks like ordinary Markdown?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Automatically deleting the old file could destroy content that is no longer explicitly engine-owned after metadata changed.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Never auto-delete the old file in v0.1. Preserve it, retain orphaned materialization provenance for diagnosis, and return attention_required until a human/project change resolves ownership.
emergent_questions.answer: Preserve and report orphaned materialization state; do not perform destructive cleanup automatically. Provide an explicit acknowledgement path that preserves both the file and prior ownership/provenance while marking the orphan resolved for future sync.
emergent_questions.decision: Removed/renamed materialization targets are non-destructive attention items. Full regeneration writes only currently registered targets and never deletes former targets. Intentional ownership transitions are resolved with explicit orphan acknowledgement (`materialize file://PATH --ack-orphan`), which preserves file bytes and historical provenance and sets `orphan_acknowledged=true`.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Post-axis correction closes DAX13/DAX14 repairability without destructive cleanup or provenance loss.

emergent_questions.question: How should a user/agent resolve an intentionally orphaned materialization record after ownership is removed, without deleting a file that may now be canonical Markdown?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: Reporting orphan attention forever without an official mutation would make a safe ownership transition impossible to complete through the supported protocol.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Provide an explicit acknowledgement mutation that preserves both file bytes and the old materialization record, adding an acknowledgement flag so sync no longer treats it as unresolved attention.
emergent_questions.answer: Use `materialize file://PATH --ack-orphan`. The file is preserved, prior owner/renderer/input/output provenance remains in materialization state, and `orphan_acknowledged=true` makes later sync treat the orphan as acknowledged.
emergent_questions.decision: Orphan repair is explicit, non-destructive and provenance-preserving; no automatic deletion or silent state pruning.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved post-acceptance DAX13/DAX14 repairability defect; no user-owned decision required.

emergent_questions.question: Should P3/P4 dependency and semantic diagnostics require successful registration of P5 project renderers?
emergent_questions.why_it_matters: A broken `register_renderers` must not make persisted dependency/semantic diagnostics unavailable; those commands do not need renderers.
emergent_questions.recommended_default: Load project renderers only for P5 materialization/sync commands. Older dependency/semantic diagnostics should load builders/rules without invoking renderer registration.
emergent_questions.answer: No. Renderer registration is component-scoped and is loaded only when a P5 command needs it; dependency/semantic diagnostics remain available independently.
emergent_questions.decision: Project extension loading separates renderer registration from dependency/semantic diagnostic paths. Renderer failures remain JSON-envelope errors for P5 commands only.
emergent_questions.acceptance_impact: Resolved post-acceptance DAX12/DAX13 cross-phase diagnostic regression; no user-owned decision required.

implementation_log.entry: Implemented renderer registry with deterministic built-in Markdown renderer and optional project `register_renderers(registry)` extension.
Implemented documentation-owned materialization digest/provenance state and drift inspection under `_dependency/state/materialization_state.json`.
Implemented safe atomic materialization for raw/derived resources, clean full regeneration and non-destructive orphan handling.
Implemented deterministic `rebuild`, affected-only/full `sync`, semantic attention preservation and bounded mixed-SCC planning.
acceptance correction: invalid project renderer registration is contained in the common JSON command error boundary instead of escaping as a traceback.
post-axis correction: derived materialization now requires current valid/auditable dependency evidence and refuses stale/changed derived targets until rebuild/check re-establishes a matching receipt.
post-axis correction: sync computes invalid/build-required outcome before materialization so audit-incomplete/invalid derived targets cannot write generated views during sync_failed.
post-axis correction: orphan attention has an official provenance-preserving acknowledgement mutation instead of a permanent unresolved loop.
post-axis correction: materialization-state loading strictly validates resource_kind/canonical paths and refuses symlinked machine-state directories.
post-axis correction: builder/renderer registration failures remain inside machine-readable CLI boundaries and renderer registration no longer blocks older dependency diagnostics.
post-axis documentation correction: `--ack-orphan` help/docs now state that acknowledgement preserves provenance rather than forgetting it.

findings: Generated ownership is explicit in materialization metadata; removed targets are preserved/reported rather than destructively deleted.
Materialization state is schema-versioned with owner/renderer/input/output digest identity and strict path parsing.
Post-axis: materialization-state parser strictly enforces schema-critical resource_kind, canonical owner/path identity and rejects malformed persisted evidence.
All writes are documentation-root confined and refuse registered-target symlink/path escapes or unowned files.
Post-axis: materialization machine-state path rejects symlinked dependency/state directories, including redirects that remain inside docs.
Affected-only sync rebuilds only missing/build_required deterministic targets and materializes only outdated/drifted/untracked outputs.
Sync preserves canonical dependency statuses; mixed semantic/deterministic SCCs are bounded and cannot cause automatic semantic convergence loops.
Post-axis: derived views cannot materialize from stale/invalid dependency evidence; sync_failed performs no generated-view writes.
Semantic targets remain review_required/stale and sync returns attention_required without editing/accepting the semantic target.
Repeat sync with unchanged inputs creates no rebuild, dependency event, output rewrite or materialization-state revision.
Managed views can be deleted/recreated; manual byte drift is detected by stored digest and repaired by clean regeneration.
Post-axis: direct materialization of derived views is receipt/state/diff-gated so output parity cannot advance ahead of validated build evidence.
rebuild/materialize/sync mutation boundaries are explicit; attention_required is successful operation, failures remain envelope errors.
Post-axis: builder/renderer registration errors stay in JSON command envelopes; orphan acknowledgement has an explicit CLI mutation.
P5 operational commands expose the common machine-readable JSON envelope; P6 will freeze the final envelope/exit-code policy.
Post-axis: dependency diagnostics remain usable with broken renderer registration and orphan attention has a supported machine-readable resolution path.
Generated-output provenance/digests are persisted and orphan ownership is diagnostically preserved.
Post-axis: orphan acknowledgement preserves old materialization provenance with `orphan_acknowledged=true` instead of deleting state; state parsing is strict.
Unrelated product/tax domain and project-defined renderer use the same core without domain-specific changes.
Positive/negative/drift/idempotency/SCC/path/renderer/CLI regression coverage exercises the P5 risk slice.
Post-axis regressions cover stale-derived materialization, audit-incomplete sync, orphan acknowledgement, persisted-state corruption/symlink safety and CLI/component isolation.
Runtime/docs/schemas/examples are synchronized; dev10 wheel/source parity and clean-venv workflow pass; final manifest-only portable-copy/ZIP gate is part of the frozen handoff procedure.
Post-axis package identity advances to dev11/v0.19 after reproduced P5 defects and CLI-help mismatch are corrected and re-audited.

acceptance_summary.notes: P5 accepted after independent post-axis audit and final dev11 package gate. Reproduced stale/invalid-derived materialization, sync no-write, orphan repairability, persisted-state strictness/symlink, component-loading and CLI/help defects are corrected and regression-tested. Q5.E3/E4 are resolved implementer decisions; no unresolved blocking/user-owned question remains before P6.
